program.name: makeblastdb
program.description: Application to create BLAST databases, version 2.17.0+

key.name: blastdb_version
key.description: Version of BLAST database to be created

key.name: gi_mask_name
key.description: Comma-separated list of masking data output files.

key.name: input_type
key.description: Type of the data specified in input_file

key.name: logfile
key.description: File to which the program log should be redirected

key.name: mask_data
key.description: Comma-separated list of input files containing masking data as produced by NCBI masking applications (e.g. dustmasker, segmasker, windowmasker)

key.name: mask_desc
key.description: Comma-separated list of free form strings to describe the masking algorithm details

key.name: mask_id
key.description: Comma-separated list of strings to uniquely identify the masking algorithm

key.name: max_file_sz
key.description: Maximum file size for BLAST database files

key.name: metadata_output_prefix
key.description: Path prefix for location of database files in metadata

key.name: out
key.description: Name of BLAST database to be created Default = input file name provided to -in argumentRequired if multiple file(s)/database(s) are provided as input

key.name: taxid
key.description: Taxonomy ID to assign to all sequences

key.name: taxid_map
key.description: Text file mapping sequence IDs to taxonomy IDs. Format:<SequenceId> <TaxonomyId><newline>

key.name: title
key.description: Title for BLAST database Default = input file name provided to -in argument

flag.name: h
flag.description: Print USAGE and DESCRIPTION; ignore all other parameters

flag.name: hash_index
flag.description: Create index of sequence hash values.

flag.name: help
flag.description: Print USAGE, DESCRIPTION and ARGUMENTS; ignore all other parameters

flag.name: help-full
flag.description: Print USAGE, DESCRIPTION and ARGUMENTS, including hidden ones; ignore all other parameters

flag.name: parse_seqids
flag.description: Option to parse seqid for FASTA input if set, for all other input types seqids are parsed automatically

flag.name: version
flag.description: Print version number; ignore other arguments
